unslop slop audit.how: For UI, landing page or dashboard tasks, walk the changed screens against the slop-sign list and write one line per sign with its fix; unresolved signs stop the review. Advisory for non-UI work.

unslop slop audit.at: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop slop audit.reach: /w-marathon › ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop slop audit.step: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop slop audit.how: In UI, landing page or dashboard streams, run the slop audit each loop pass and treat unresolved signs as an unmet build gate. Advisory for non-UI streams.

unslop direction brief.how: For UI, landing page or dashboard tasks, write the five-line direction (product, character, world, moments, signature) into the plan before any visual change; advisory otherwise.
For UI, landing page or dashboard streams, derive the direction from the product and confirm it in the single interview batch; advisory for non-UI work.

unslop triage and refine-only gate.how: For UI, landing page or dashboard tasks, grade the existing screen as heavy, light or no slop and ask the user to confirm the direction in the interview; advisory otherwise.
For UI, landing page or dashboard streams, include the triage grade and refine-only option in the kickoff question; advisory for non-UI work.

unslop ordered redline passes.how: When building or redesigning UI, landing page or dashboard screens, apply the nine passes in order, finishing each across the whole screen; advisory otherwise.

unslop ordered redline passes.at: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop ordered redline passes.reach: /w-marathon › ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop ordered redline passes.step: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop ordered redline passes.how: In UI, landing page or dashboard streams, run one ordered pass per loop iteration from spacing to motion; advisory for non-UI streams.

unslop design tokens.how: For UI, landing page or dashboard specs, use the token sheet as starting values for spacing, ramps, type and motion unless the project already has a system; advisory otherwise.

unslop design tokens.at: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop design tokens.reach: /w-marathon › ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop design tokens.step: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop design tokens.how: In UI streams, pull spacing, color, radius and motion values from the token sheet when the project has none; advisory for non-UI work.

unslop glyph and duotone effects.how: When a landing page hero image needs to match the palette, offer one glyph, halftone, dither or duotone treatment on the main visual only; advisory otherwise.

unslop glyph and duotone effects.at: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop glyph and duotone effects.reach: /w-marathon › ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop glyph and duotone effects.step: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop glyph and duotone effects.how: In landing page streams with a hero image, apply a single duotone or glyph treatment in the visuals pass; advisory for non-UI streams.

unslop visual direction.how: For landing page or empty-state work, decide whether a visual is needed and write it as one plain sentence before any generation; advisory for dashboards and non-UI work.

unslop visual direction.at: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop visual direction.reach: /w-marathon › ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop visual direction.step: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop visual direction.how: In landing page streams, choose the visual style and write the prompt recipe only after the screen works without it; advisory for non-UI work.

unslop image generation gate.how: Before any paid image generation for a UI or landing page, show prompt, model and size and wait for approval; if declined leave an empty slot and put the prompt in the report.

unslop image generation gate.at: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop image generation gate.reach: /w-marathon › ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop image generation gate.step: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop image generation gate.how: Before any paid image generation in a UI or landing page stream, require approval of prompt, model and size; declined means an empty slot, not a stalled loop.

unslop live page snapshot.how: When a UI redesign starts from only a live URL, save a static HTML copy and screenshot to work on and compare against; advisory otherwise.
For UI or landing page streams that begin from a live link, snapshot the page once up front as the baseline copy; advisory for non-UI work.

unslop story video renderer.how: When the user asks for a before-and-after video of a UI redesign, render the story page to MP4 with the headless browser and ffmpeg; advisory and optional.

unslop story video authoring.how: When a before-and-after story video is requested for a UI redesign, spec the story page as three to five CSS-only steps with redlines; advisory otherwise.

unslop story video authoring.at: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop story video authoring.reach: /w-marathon › ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop story video authoring.step: ⛔ CHECKPOINT 4: Loop — per stream, until the build gate is met
unslop story video authoring.how: In UI streams that ship a redesign story, author the story steps from the original screen after the passes are done; advisory for non-UI work.

unslop do-not list and final checklist.how: For UI, landing page or dashboard work, check the redesign against the do-not list, the closing checklist and the swap-the-product-name template test; failures stop the review. Advisory for non-UI work.
For UI, landing page or dashboard streams, confirm the do-not limits and template-fit test before closing; advisory for non-UI work.
